title: Fix percentile ordinal grammar (30.3th → 30.3rd)
prompt: In frontend/src/pages/OrganizationDetail.tsx, find everywhere a peer_percentile or ntee1_percentile is rendered as an ordinal (e.g. '30.3th'). Write a formatOrdinal(n) helper that returns the correct suffix: 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th ... 11th, 12th, 13th ... 21st, 22nd, 23rd. Use it for all percentile displays. Build passes with: cd frontend && npm run build.

title: Show Program Expense Ratio on org detail
prompt: In frontend/src/pages/OrganizationDetail.tsx, find the financial metrics section (near months_of_reserve and net_assets). Add a 'Program Expense Ratio' stat using apiOrg.program_expense_pct (already in API response). Display as '72%' with helper text 'Share of spending that goes to programs'. Only show when program_expense_pct is not null. Build: cd frontend && npm run build.

title: Add Revenue Trend arrow to org detail
prompt: In frontend/src/pages/OrganizationDetail.tsx, the RevenueChart component receives historical financials. After the chart, add a one-line 'Revenue Trend' badge: calculate % change from oldest to newest year in the financials array. Show ↗ +12% (green), ↘ -5% (red), or → flat (gray). Handle divide-by-zero and single-year cases. Build: cd frontend && npm run build.

title: Add 'Basic listing' banner for stub orgs
prompt: In frontend/src/pages/OrganizationDetail.tsx, detect stub orgs: apiOrg.source === 'bmf_stub' AND apiOrg.total_revenue === null. For these, render a soft info banner below the org header: 'This organization is IRS-registered but hasn't filed a full 990. Financial data and a MERIT score aren't available yet.' Use the existing warm-cream / light-grey palette. Do not show the score section or revenue chart for stubs. Build: cd frontend && npm run build.

title: Add Verify This Data footer to org detail
prompt: At the bottom of OrganizationDetail.tsx (before the similar orgs strip), add a compact 'Verify this listing' section with three external links: 1) IRS Tax Exempt Search — https://apps.irs.gov/app/eos/detailsPage?ein={EIN} 2) ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer — https://projects.propublica.org/nonprofits/organizations/{EIN} 3) State charity registry (link to NASCONET: https://www.nasconet.org/resources/state-government/). Style as small grey text links, no visual weight. Build: cd frontend && npm run build.
